integrity: The uniform proof is explicit linear algebra over \(\mathbb F_2\); a separate finite verifier checks every pair of vertices for \(3\le n\le8\). No independent external audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: This is an exact combinatorial reduction, not a general homotopy or homology classification. The \(n=5\) instance overlaps the previously studied scale-three regime, and the literature search cannot certify absolute global novelty.
title: A parity reduction of penultimate hypercube Rips complexes
